entities.name: Bilagru
entities.description: Twelve-foot giant Orzhov executioner and chief enforcer collecting debts for Ilona.

entities.name: Lord Kazmyr
entities.description: Creature droning "Bilagru will come for you."

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: Planeswalker and acting guildmaster of the Orzhov.

entities.name: Maladola
entities.description: Suggested building Kaya's Honor Guard around Bilagru.

events.summary: Bilagru is sent to collect Symond Halm's head; Symond kills a vedalken to hide in an Azorius prison.
events.quote: Bilagru was sent to collect his head

events.summary: Bilagru watches Symond arrested and calls him "debtor".
events.quote: Bilagru intoned one single word to Symond

events.summary: Bilagru fights through the Azorius prison and reaches Symond's cell, telling him debts must be paid and raising his axe.
During the War of the Spark Bilagru offers his services to Kaya, who convinces him to protect the Syndicate from the Eternals.
events.quote: Bilagru agreed to mobilize his enforcers and the Syndicate's military might

events.summary: Bilagru and another Orzhov giant protect Kaya in battle against the Eternals.
events.quote: Bilagru and another Orzhov giant protected Kaya during a chaotic battle against the Eternals.

relations.quote: chief enforcer serving to collect debts to kingpin Ilona and the church militant
Bilagru is an ally of Kaya and Tomik Vrona
Bilagru was sent to collect his head
